messages:
sara_sales: Quick sync — AuroraEdge POC is ready for the private deployment stage. They need instructions for providing credentials and certs so we can import keys into their dedicated Private runtime. Main asks: KMS/HSM exchange process, recommended cert format, and a temporary access flow for the 2-week POC.
lee_se: Got it. Do we know if they want us to import keys into their KMS (customer-managed) or to plug into their on-prem HSM?
aj_infra: AuroraEdge said they have an HSM appliance (PKCS#11) and an Azure KMS backup. Primary plan is HSM -> we need either remote import (pkcs11) or they give us an attested wrapped key.
marta_sec: Security constraints: we require an attestation proof for any key material. For HSM, we need an HSM attestation cert + a signed CSR from their admin. No raw key files over email. We can accept a wrapped key blob encrypted with our import key.
sara_sales: OK — customer asked for a short checklist we can provide. Can you draft the minimal steps we need so I can share?
lee_se: Draft checklist (send as single-comment to customer):
1) Create CSR on their HSM appliance or local CA with CN=auroraedge-poc, include subjectAltName for their VPC endpoint.
2) Provide HSM attestation cert (manufacturer-signed) or exported EK cert.
3) If doing key import: wrap the key using our import public key (we'll provide a one-time import pubkey).
4) Supply the cert chain in PEM, and a PKCS#12 bundle if they prefer client certs.
5) Provide temporary SFTP upload + one-time token for the wrapped blobs and CSR.
6) Confirm maintenance window for rotating test certs (we recommend 14 days TTL for POC).

lee_se: Example commands they can run to generate CSR (if using OpenSSL):
```
# generate a new RSA key + CSR
openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:4096 -out client.key
openssl req -new -key client.key -out client.csr -subj "/CN=auroraedge-poc" -addext "subjectAltName = DNS:private.rw-aurora.poc"
```

marta_sec: If they must use PKCS#11 (HSM), here's an example for PKCS#11 util: use the vendor tool to generate the key and produce CSR. We'll accept CSR + attestation.
aj_infra: For import token, we will issue a time-limited import keypair. I can generate the import pubkey and a single-use upload URL. Any objections?
sara_sales: Sounds good. Add: firewall rules — open outbound to our control plane and allow incoming from our provisioning IPs (I'll paste ranges).
lee_se: Also need a service account on their side with the following IAM roles: KeyManagement.Import, Network.Peering.Read, VPC.Endpoint.Attach. If they prefer, we can create a short-lived service token instead.
aj_infra: I'll prepare the import pubkey and a signed statement with fingerprint + expiry. plan to rotate after 24h for security.

deploy-bot: Ticket #POC-9421 created: "auroraedge private cred exchange" assigned to @aj_infra, @lee_se, SLA 3d

sara_sales: Customer wants the exact file formats to upload. Can you enumerate accepted file names and MIME types?
lee_se: Accepted artifacts: client.csr (text/plain or application/pem-certificate-chain), client-cert.pem (PEM), client-chain.pem (PEM), wrapped-key.blob (application/octet-stream), attestation.json (application/json). If they send a PKCS12: client.p12 (application/x-pkcs12).
marta_sec: Also require a signed manifest: manifest.json with fields: {"upload_ts":..., "uploader":..., "artifact_list":[...], "sha256":...} — signed by their admin with their key. We verify signature against the attestation cert.
sara_sales: Perfect. I'll pass this to AuroraEdge and ask for ETA. I'll link the SFTP upload when AJ posts it.
aj_infra: Upload link and one-time import pubkey will be posted here by EOD UTC. I'll also include the expiration timestamp and the audit GUID.
lee_se: One more: confirm TLS ciphers we accept for the private runtime (no TLS1.0/1.1, prefer TLS1.2+ and ECDHE). I'll paste cipher string in follow-up.
sara_sales: Thanks team — cc @marta_sec for final approval on wording. I'll update the POC plan doc after the customer confirms. :thumbsup:
